title: Contextual Golden Simulator for Probabilistic Quant Acceptance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build an automated validation harness that simulates realistic request distributions against quantized model variants (FP8/INT8) using contextual golden prompt cohorts. The simulator will produce multidimensional pass/fail decisions using metric families (semantic-embedding similarity, token-level divergence, hallucination detectors, and task-specific fidelity metrics). The goal is to provide a deterministic acceptance gate for CI and canary rollouts that accounts for contextual sensitivity and per-layer degradation signals.
goal: Ship a reproducible acceptance gate that can be used in PR pipelines and runtime rollouts to automatically block quantized model variants that cause statistically significant semantic regression on realistic traffic cohorts.
design_notes: Golden cohorts are curated by traffic-weighted sampling + manual seed expansion to cover edge contexts (legal, finance, short prompt injection cases).
Introduce stochastic perturbation mode that mutates prompts (typos, paraphrase, tokenization edgecases) to surface brittle regressions under quantization.
Per-layer sensitivity profiles will weight failures more heavily when high-sensitivity layers are implicated by gradient-based influence heuristics.

Acceptance criteria combine a primary semantic metric (embedding cosine >= baseline - delta) with secondary signal checks (token perplexity spike threshold, hallucination classifier FPR increase limit).
Simulator runs will produce a deterministic fingerprint (hash of cohort+seed+model-commit+quant-profile) to enable auditability and reproducible comparisons.
Expose an API to pull run artifacts (deltas, failure cohorts) and link to dashboards for humans-in-the-loop review.
Run orchestration integrates with existing calibration pipelines and can schedule nightly full-suite runs and lightweight PR smoke checks.
Failure modes defined: regression (semantic drop), instability (high variance across stochastic perturbations), and catastrophic shift (task degradation beyond absolute threshold).
We will maintain a small set of canonical golden seeds and an extended traffic-derived pool; both are versioned and signed in the golden-store.
Telemetry: emit structured events to Datadog/OTel with tags: model, quant_profile, cohort, seed, run_hash, and metric_family for downstream alerting and dashboarding.
acceptance_criteria: CI smoke runs: new quant profile must complete a 10k sample smoke suite within CI budget and return a pass/fail result.
Nightly full run: end-to-end pipeline runs on scheduled infra and produces run artifacts pushed to object storage with stable naming conventions.
Metric gating: embedding cosine means not decrease by more than 1.5% on golden cohort; hallucination FPR increase <= 0.5 percentage points; token perplexity aggregate increase <= 5%.
Reproducibility: identical inputs+seed+model produce identical run_hash and delta artifacts in two independent runs.
Rollback automation: failure in canary triggers automated routing to fallback model and creates a rollback incident ticket template populated with run diagnostics.
Dashboard: a Console dashboard tile displays pass/fail, top failing queries, per-layer sensitivity heatmap, and trendline vs baseline.
PR integration: a GitHub check reports pass/fail and links to a minimal diagnostic summary for reviewer approval.
Security: run artifacts don't include raw customer PII; golden cohorts must be scrubbed/consented where applicable.
steps: Define golden cohort taxonomy (short prompts, long context, code, instruction-turns, slot-filling).
Implement stochastic perturbation engine (typo generator, paraphraser, token-chop).
Instrument metric families: embedding-similarity, KL/token-perplexity, hallucination classifier, task-specific scorers.
Prototype per-layer sensitivity estimator based on hook gradients and activation shifts between baseline and quantized weights.
Create run orchestration (K8s CronJob + Argo workflow) for nightly/full runs and PR-smoke variants.
Build result aggregator that computes pass/fail and generates run_hash + artifact bundle, push to S3-compatible store.
Expose a lightweight API endpoint for GH CI to trigger smoke checks and fetch summarized results.
Wire telemetry into Datadog/OTel and add Console dashboard components for Signal/Alert authors.
Create canary rollout policy that consumes gate results and supports traffic-weighted rollouts + automatic fallback on failure.

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Overfitting the gate to golden set leads to false confidence. Mitigation: maintain separate holdout sets and randomize seeds; require two successive run pass before promoting a profile.
Risk: CI runtime cost for full-suite is high. Mitigation: split into smoke vs full; require only smoke for PRs and nightly full-run for release candidates.
Risk: Metric drift in baseline. Mitigation: baseline recalibration cadence (monthly) and automated drift detection with human review workflow.

Risk: Quantization reveals brittle behavior only in adversarial paraphrases. Mitigation: include adversarial perturbation bucket and increase weight in pass/fail scoring if failures concentrated there.
